mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vi_file WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_file SET upload_lease_token=#{token}, upload_lease_until=#{until,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADING' AND upload_lease_token IS NULL AND version=#{version}

UPDATE vi_file SET status=#{status},mime_type=#{mimeType},server_size=#{serverSize}, server_sha256=#{serverSha256},media_duration_millis=#{mediaDurationMillis}, media_width=#{mediaWidth},media_height=#{mediaHeight},media_video_codec=#{mediaVideoCodec}, media_audio_codec=#{mediaAudioCodec},upload_lease_until=NULL,upload_lease_token=NULL, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('UPLOADING','VERIFYING')
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.owner_dept_id,c.status,d.status dept_status,d.del_flag dept_delete FROM vi_training_course c LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=c.owner_dept_id WHERE c.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.account_id,a.status,a.reject_fields FROM vi_driver_application a JOIN vi_driver_profile p ON p.id=a.driver_id WHERE a.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.account_id FROM vi_driver_application a JOIN vi_driver_profile p ON p.id=a.driver_id WHERE a.id=#{id}
SELECT s.dept_id FROM vi_station s JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=s.dept_id WHERE s.id=#{id} AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_order o JOIN vi_driver_assignment a ON a.id=o.active_assignment_id JOIN vi_driver_profile d ON d.id=a.driver_id WHERE o.id=#{orderId} AND a.order_id=o.id AND d.account_id=#{accountId} AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND o.returned_at IS NULL AND o.fulfillment_status NOT IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED','COMPLETED')

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vi_aftersale_case c WHERE c.order_id=#{orderId} AND ( JSON_CONTAINS(c.evidence_ids,JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{fileId} AS CHAR)))=1 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM vi_aftersale_note n WHERE n.case_id=c.id AND JSON_CONTAINS(n.evidence_ids,JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{fileId} AS CHAR)))=1 ) ) )
